terbaru.judul: CodeShrink: Adaptive Visual Compression for Efficient Multimodal Code Understanding
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose CodeShrink, an adaptive visual compression framework with three components.
We introduce DiffusionGemma, an experimental open-weight language model that uses discrete diffusion to generate text at exceptionally high speed.

terbaru.judul: DungeonBench: A Benchmark for Rules-Rich Tactical Reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons Combat
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce DungeonBench, a benchmark for tactical reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons combat, built to cover the vast majority of combat-relevant 2014 System Reference Document content whose effects can be resolved by the simulator while retaining mechanics that simplified combat simulators often abstract away.

terbaru.judul: LEMUR: Learning to Align with Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning from Preference Feedback
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we bridge this gap with LEMUR: Learning to Align with Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Preference feedback, a novel framework where an agent interactively learns from the preferences of multiple humans to learn optimal multi-objective policies.

terbaru.judul: Don't Mix Rewards, Mix Policies: Policy Decomposition and Optimization for Multi-Reward RL
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we propose PRISM, a new multi-reward RL framework built upon the idea of policy-space decomposition and composition.

terbaru.judul: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce $β$-OPSD and derive its optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher.

terbaru.judul: Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs
terbaru.pelajaran: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints.

terbaru.judul: Policy-Level Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied AI with a Criticality World Model
terbaru.pelajaran: Despite advances in policy pretraining, embodied AI systems can plateau during task-specific fine-tuning as uniform scenario collection encounters fewer of the remaining failures.

terbaru.judul: Kalman Meets Curriculum: Efficient Dynamic Prompt Selection for Adaptive RL Finetuning
terbaru.pelajaran: To address these issues, we propose a Kalman-Guided Prompt Selection method (KGPS), which reformulates prompt selection as a dynamic state estimation problem rather than static difficulty prediction.

terbaru.judul: Post-Training at the Edge of Detectability: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Fine-Tuning
terbaru.pelajaran: Specifically, we study a sequential game in which an agent chooses a policy to maximize cumulative reward while a monitor observes policy outputs over time and tests for deviations from the reference policy.
